purpose: Correct the earlier noise-floor claim; recomputed from the saved 24x4 outputs, no new teacher sampling
identity: mean_k KL(p_k || q) = mean_k KL(p_k || p_bar) + KL(p_bar || q)

requirements_checked.same_direction: all terms are KL(teacher || student) style; no JS distance, no reversed KL

retracted_claim.text: the student sits at the noise floor; student error and teacher noise are the same magnitude
retracted_claim.why_retracted: it divided KL(p_bar||q) by the PAIRWISE mean KL(p_i||p_j), which is not the first term of the identity
retracted_claim.clustered_note: even the corrected terms are estimates from K=4 teacher runs, not exact population quantities

clustering.note: roots within one battle are not independent; the intervals resample battles

relabel_experiment.valid_conclusion: under the current evidence, raising teacher budget is not the priority; freeze the teacher for now
relabel_experiment.invalid_conclusion: higher teacher budget reduces strength - no significance test and no independent action-value result under a common frozen reference was computed
relabel_experiment.also_invalid: comparing the two runs' losses directly: the relabelled evaluation labels also changed, so the two losses are not on one frozen reference
